services.name: Tuscarora Disc Golf Course
services.desc: Tuscarora Park has an 18 Hole Disc Golf course on which was installed by Plastic Addicts Disc Golf Supplies owner Johnnie Harrison and course designer Kip Taufer. The first 9 holes were installed in the fall of 2016 and the other 9 were added the summer of 2018. This course is very challenging with a fun layout for all skill levels to play. Five of the holes are out in the open but require an accurate shot to reach the target. The course includes 3 very picturesque disc golf holes up on Reeder’s Knob with the other holes nestled in the hills and trees on the other side of the creek.
